items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: Clyde Wilson, you know that English trumpet player said he'd do it at charity one night.

ctx.x: Oh, man, when I first stayed in sick, I couldn't stand up last night when I was trying to walk. Mm-hmm. Yeah, I couldn't stand up. And you came back by the house and saw me back then. Mm-hmm. I remember. Yeah, I was confined to bed, man, just lay down and get up and sit down. I couldn't stand up. But now, since I've been walking with the pressures, I do fine.
I go anywhere I want to go. Yeah, I played with the project down in charity. Mm-hmm. Yeah, Clyde Wilson, you know that English trumpet player said he'd do it at charity one night.
Yeah, I played the project down in charity.
